As Apple (AAPL) Valuation Rose, Bedell Frazier Investment Counseling Has Raised Stake; Broadview Advisors Position in Crane Co (CR) Trimmed by $5.21 Million as Stock Value Declined
June 11, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Bedell Frazier Investment Counseling Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 2.54% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bedell Frazier Investment Counseling Llc bought 2,849 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 115,017 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $19.30 million, up from 112,168 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bedell Frazier Investment Counseling Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $940.81B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.15% or $0.289 $191.411. About 14.19M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
